items.title: Invite another photographer into your workspace
items.body: In Collaborate, open Workspace access, find a photographer by their email and send an invitation. Once they accept, they can handle your bookings, clients, events and opportunities with you, and you can remove their access at any time.

items.title: Switch between your workspace and one you were invited to
items.body: If another photographer invites you, accept it in Collaborate, then pick their workspace from the chip at the top. You see their balance and analytics, but withdrawals and the transaction history stay with the owner, and your own account stays separate.

items.title: See your events and payments by day
items.body: Event coordinators now have a Calendar screen with Month, Week and Agenda views. Your events appear on their date with the time and place, live events are marked, and payments you still owe show on their due date.

items.title: Filter and jump straight to the work
items.body: Filter the calendar to events, live events or payments, tap Today to come back, and open an event or the payments screen straight from its card. Find Calendar on your Home screen and in the More menu.

releases.title: The client wallet ring now always shows

items.title: Your wallet ring includes what you have spent
items.body: The Analytics tab of the client wallet now shows its ring as soon as you have spent money, alongside your balance, refunds, tips, gifts, donations and what is still processing.

releases.title: A new look for the update screen

items.title: The update screen has a fresh gradient look
items.body: The screen that appears when a new version is ready now has a dark background with a soft blue and teal glow and a blue to mint Update now button. What it says and how it works are unchanged.

releases.title: A clearer balance ring in the wallet Analytics tab

items.title: The ring no longer overlaps its figures
items.body: In the wallet Analytics tab the total now fits inside the ring, and every amount in the list shows your currency with two decimals instead of a long raw number.

items.title: Clients now see the balance ring too
items.body: The client wallet Analytics tab now shows the same ring as the photographer and event coordinator wallets, built from your balance, refunds, tips, gifts, donations and what is still processing.
